articles.title: Satya Niketan is Emptying Out: Building Collapse Sends Students Fleeing Their PGs
articles.description: Two days after a building collapsed in Delhi's Satya Niketan, suitcases and backpacks have become the new normal in its narrow lanes. Students are calling parents, scouting new accommodation, and some are sleeping in colleges at night, too scared to stay. Several nearby buildings have been flagged "unsafe," and one is already being vacated for demolition. Residents say poor ventilation, dangerous staircases, and inadequate fire safety have long been ignored in the area. For many students, the choice now comes down to two things: affordability, and staying alive.
